text:
lina: Heads up — Node SDK doesn't expose the admin models listing we rely on in the onboarding sample app. Hit this when updating sampleapp to the v2 catalog flow.

samir: which path do you mean? /v1/admin/models/list or the older endpoint?

lina: /v1/admin/models/list (POST) — our curl in the quickstart uses it directly. Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/models/list -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{}'
```
I expected the SDK call to be something like `await client.admin.models.list()` but it's undefined / 404 right now.

anya: this breaks the sampleapp e2e on CI — the setup step that seeds the demo model fails. devex-e2e shows 404 for admin list.

devex-bot: sampleapp-e2e failed: job 8472 — step "seed-models" returned exit code 1. Log excerpt: "POST /v1/admin/models/list -> 404 Not Found"

michael: we intentionally kept admin surface minimal in the public SDK because admin endpoints require stricter auth and are sensitive. But agreed we can't leave the quickstart in a broken state.

samir: we have two problems: (1) missing endpoint in SDK surface, (2) parameter name drift — REST expects `status` query/body field, while older SDKs used `state`. That mismatch is causing silent differences across environments.

lina: yep — on private deployments the backend doesn't map `state` -> `status`, so sampleapp shows no models. CI with hosted env was more forgiving.

anya: TL;DR: onboarding friction — devs hit a 404/empty list depending on env and token type. Quick steps to fix would be nice.

michael: proposal: expose admin.listModels() on server-side SDKs but gate it behind a beta flag / require explicit opt-in in config. Also normalize the param name to `status` in SDKs to match REST.

samir: plan I can execute: open PR to node-sdk to add `client.admin.models.list()` (mirrors REST body), add an alias that accepts both `state` and `status` for backwards compat, and add tests hitting the stubbed admin route. Will also add a note in the SDK changelog about auth requirements.

lina: please also update sampleapp quickstart to use the SDK call (with a comment about needing a server-side key) and add a comment in the docs about admin scope + KMS gating.

anya: quick note on auth: SDK creates ephemeral session tokens in some templates; the sampleapp env uses a long-lived key. We should document which keys are valid for admin routes. CI used ephemeral and got 401s sometimes.

samir: good call — I'll ping security to clarify which token types we allow for admin endpoints and put that in the SDK readme.

michael: timeline: samir to open PR today, target patch release next week, update sampleapp + CI after SDK cut. I'll loop in security and product on the feature-gating decision.

lina: opening GH issue and linking this thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/issues/789 (adding notes). Assigning to @samir.

samir: noted. I'm adding unit tests and a tiny integration harness to the PR.

anya: :thumbsup: will watch CI and update the onboarding doc once the SDK patch is published.

devex-bot: task created: DEVEX-4567 "Expose admin.models.list in SDK + normalize status param" — assigned to samir.

michael: thanks everyone — small win for parity and onboarding.

lina: thanks!
